name: Breeze
source:
Formerly a professional boxer, he was blackmailed by the Over Heaven Society after he took part in a fixed fight at a mixed martial arts tournament organized by the Dark Tiger in Macau.
He divorced Yen and retired from boxing in exchange for a settlement money from his wife Yen's parents.
He then began working as a bouncer at the Amaryllis nightclub, where he beat to death a customer who persisted in following the hostess.
Yeung Kwun asked him to join the Red Flower Society in exchange for handling the case, and Breeze accepted and became a member of the Red Flower Society.
He was later imprisoned for three years for the murder of Terry, who had suggested that he had harmed Yen.
After his release, he opened a gym and became an executive of the Red Flower Society.
